domain: AMENDMENT-CHAIN-SHAPE (the mandatory structure axis: conditioning on the GEOMETRY of the chain set - where the re-addressal mass sits - never on corrected values, never on timing/cadence/span observables)
title: Correction-mass concentration: long diffuse-patch filers, short localized-defect filers, per-sector net-zero on the death-inclusive cohort, conditioned on last_avail vintage stamps

mechanism_lineage.lineage: restatement-strain / disclosure-credibility, SHAPE branch. The conditioner is the amendment PROCESS STRUCTURE (the geometry of the entity's chain set: how its beyond-modal re-addressal mass is distributed across certified field-periods); the corrected values themselves - direction, magnitude, content - are never read, and no timing/cadence/span observable enters any arm (the V11-measured-dead cadence axis and the duration-adjacent census observables are not touched).
mechanism_lineage.who_is_forced_to_trade_or_slow_to_react: The constrained actor is the issuer's financial-reporting and audit machinery. Once a certified vintage of a field-period exists, every further re-addressal is a compelled act of that machinery, dragged out by internal friction. The SHAPE of where those compelled acts land is not chosen by management either: a machinery with one broken cycle/account keeps re-opening the SAME certified period (localized), while a machinery doing routine hygiene (reclassifications, resegmentations, presentation conformances) spreads its patches thinly across many field-periods (diffuse). The slow-to-react actor is the marginal holder, who prices earnings headlines and never forms the cross-chain geometry of an issuer's patch history, so the localization state is not repriced when it accrues.
mechanism_lineage.why_concentration_reveals_state: Material weakness in financial reporting is account-specific: it localizes in particular cycles (revenue recognition, inventory, reserves) rather than spreading uniformly across the chart of accounts. Define excess(g) = depth(g) - 2, the re-addressals beyond the modal single patch. The exposure is the share of the entity's total excess mass contributed by its single most-re-addressed chain: max_g excess(g) / sum_g excess(g). High concentration = one specific, unresolved defect the machinery keeps re-opening (a localized material-weakness state); low concentration = routine cleanup spread thin. Two entities with IDENTICAL average depth sit at opposite ends - fifty chains at depth 6 give concentration near the diffuse floor; one chain at depth 31 among shallow peers gives concentration near 1 (both regimes have mass in the census histogram: 122,524 groups at depth 6-10 and 118 above depth 20). The literature ties localized process failure to material weakness and elevated information risk; the state persists into relative underperformance and an elevated death hazard, measurable only on the death-inclusive cohort (DEAD_EVIDENCED entities carry 1,023,812 of 1,667,422 chain groups, 61.4% - a survivor-only panel would censor the hazard out of the short leg).
mechanism_lineage.why_beyond_spy_and_sector_beta: The exposure is a firm-specific property of the issuer's own evidenced filing geometry: it exists at the entity level before any price forms, carries no market or sector content by construction, and the book is built per-sector net-zero with the risk-matched SPY-excess and sector-ETF gates binding unchanged. If localization carried only beta, the SPY-excess gate kills it; the mechanism claims a cross-sectional disclosure-credibility spread INSIDE sectors, not a market or sector timer.
mechanism_lineage.what_the_book_does: A per-sector net-zero tercile long-short on the death-inclusive cohort: long diffuse-patch filers (low concentration), short localized-defect filers (high concentration), decisions on the inherited 21-session grid, one grid step holding with rank hysteresis, exits at last close for dead legs, band-model costs charged exactly once per fill, stress tier x2 on booked PnL as a primary gate.
mechanism_lineage.when_it_must_fail: (i) localization is efficiently priced: anchor expectancy <= 0 after base costs; (ii) the shuffled-chain control reproduces the anchor at >= 0.5x same-sign alpha - then the spread is a distributional artifact of the exposure's shape (group-count composition, sector composition, tie structure), not entity-linked structure information, and the family dies (falsification-by-control, the V11 precedent on this same census); (iii) fewer than 2 of 3 folds positive or drop-one expectancy <= 0; (iv) any pre-selection identifiability or novelty gate fails - the proposal dies at D2 before any scored cell, the cheap death.

falsifiable_prediction: Within-sector correction-mass concentration predicts next-quarter relative returns: the high-concentration tercile (short) underperforms the low-concentration tercile (long) in at least 2 of 3 folds S0_FOLD_1/2/3 after band costs, with (a) anchor expectancy > 0; (b) position PF >= 1.10; (c) populated-fold PF >= 0.8; (d) risk-matched SPY-excess alpha > 0 overall and positive in >= 1/3 of folds; (e) ETF positive share <= 0.50 (expected 0.00 - the book holds no ETF legs); (f) max fold MDD <= 0.15; (g) fold positive-share/concentration <= 0.50; (h) the stress tier (cost_mult 2.0 on booked PnL) survives; (i) the shuffled-chain control's |alpha| < 0.5x the anchor's alpha - same-sign reproduction at >= 0.5x kills the family; (j) the peak-excess-severity neighbour supports with same-sign alpha; (k) pre-selection gates R1-R5 and pooled |rho| <= 0.20 vs ALL THIRTEEN veto entries pass at D2 before selection. Failure interpretations are preregistered in failure_interpretation - none is a tuning opportunity. Availability-lag mutation (P3 invariant, extended): pushing any last_avail stamp later shifts the entity's exposure by at most one decision-grid step and changes nothing else; any larger shift is an implementation leak and the arm is NOT_RUN fail-closed.

universe.dead_leg_honesty: exit-at-last-close semantics carried from the V9/V10/V11 P3 payloads: a held name whose series ends is exited at its last recorded close on its final session; the delisting return is carried by the price series itself - no survivorship re-substitution, no synthetic penalty, no synthetic continuation. Exit costs via resolve_exit_band_bps (own band when tradable, C-rate 25 bps ceiling when UNTRADABLE/missing), never the silent fallback (L-I3 fail-closed). clock.conditioning_rule: P2 clock semantics verbatim: chain-STRUCTURE conditioners are available at the group's LAST vintage stamp (last_avail): depth, span-shape, dead-leg composition - the PROCESS STRUCTURE only. The cadence/inter-arrival axis is V11-measured-DEAD and enters no arm; the span component of S2 is likewise never read (duration observables sit adjacent to the dead axis). A decision at session t observes a group only if last_avail < gate(t), gate(t) = 00:00 UTC of the decision session; staleness bound 0 <= t - last_avail <= 800 days (max_age_days 800 everywhere; no unbounded variant). deadline_distance is DATA_BLOCKED_VALID and is never cited (P-1). No span, no inter_arrival_days, no first_avail lag, no corrected value, no direction, no magnitude enters any arm.
clock.availability_evidence: P-1 absolute: the vintage stamps ARE the evidence. Every conditioning row is a staged depth>=2 chain group with a recorded evidenced last_avail stamp; asserted timestamps are never used. The conditioner never reads a price series; the only price-derived quantities anywhere are the inherited eligibility/cost floors (63-bar, ADV63, close >= 1.00), which are machinery, not signal.

arms.arms_note: exactly three arms per binding rule - anchor, neighbour, control; every other key in this object is a note, not an arm. All arms RUN under evidenced semantics (P-3): every input row is a staged depth>=2 chain group with a recorded evidenced last_avail stamp; nothing asserted, nothing imputed; each arm is testable under the P3 availability-lag mutation; the control recomputes under any semantics change.
arms.anchor: excess-mass concentration exposure: conc(e,t) = max_g excess(g) / sum_g excess(g) over g in Q(e,t), where excess(g) = depth(g) - 2, per-sector long-low/short-high terciles. Degenerate case declared ex ante: an entity with sum_g excess(g) = 0 (a pure single-patch book) maps to the diffuse floor 0.0 - monotone-consistent (zero excess is LESS localized strain than any positive ratio), principled, not tuned. Claim: the share of an entity's beyond-modal re-addressal mass sitting in its single worst chain predicts negative drift on the localized names.
arms.neighbour: peak excess severity (required SUPPORT, same sign): peak_excess(e,t) = max_g depth(g) - 2 over Q(e,t) - the raw re-addressal count of the entity's single worst chain, a level extreme with no normalization. Materially different structure cut, not a parameter wiggle: an unnormalized worst-case level vs a normalized mass share - an entity can carry a severe peak (peak_excess 10+) inside a diffuse book (low concentration) and vice versa (moderate peaks in a small book give concentration 1 mechanically only when |Q| is tiny, which the |Q| >= 4 floor guards). If the severity reading carries the opposite sign, the localization interpretation is withdrawn (declared support-failure, not a tuning opportunity).
arms.control: shuffled-chain falsification control preserving marginals (MANDATORY per P3 lane1_control_mandate): for each decision date t, within each sector tag, permute the anchor's conc values uniformly across that sector's eligible names (numpy PCG64 seed 20260909, permutation applied to the CIK-sorted index vector, re-drawn per decision date in session-index order - fully deterministic and frozen). Equivalently: each entity's evidenced chain-geometry summary is reassigned across sector-matched entities while the exact per-sector exposure value multiset is preserved. Matching rule: within-sector, both sides CIK-sorted, permutation index from the frozen seed; no outcome input anywhere; the control runs on the same staged evidenced exposures (it permutes measured values, asserts nothing) and recomputes under any semantics change (P-3). The control book runs the IDENTICAL per-sector tercile machinery on the permuted exposures. Kill rule: control |alpha| >= 0.5x anchor |alpha| with the same sign on the identifying metric (anchor overall risk-matched SPY-excess alpha) -> the spread is a distributional artifact, not entity-linked structure information -> the family is falsified per the falsification-by-control cluster (RULES section 2.3).
arms.intended_correlation_profile_and_why_it_: anchor vs control: by marginal preservation the control's rank structure is a random relabelling of the anchor's - declared expected pooled Spearman rho 0.00-0.10, gate 0.30 (pre_selection_identifiability_check R1). The control's discriminating power: an artifact (composition, ties, sector shape) lives in the value multiset and survives permutation; entity-linked structure content does not. Correlation declared ex ante, measured at D2 before selection, never argued post hoc.

book_form.form: daily long/short equity book on the death-inclusive cohort, constructed per-sector net-zero: within each sector tag with >= 6 eligible ranked names, long the bottom tercile and short the top tercile of the exposure (descending = short), equal-weight within legs, per-sector net zero; CASH absorbs residual; >= 1 non-CASH leg per decision; gross capped 2.0; all books reconcile to 1.0 within 1e-9. Tercile boundaries: midrank ties at a boundary join the lower (long) tercile - deterministic and conservative (the short leg is strictly the highest exposures).
book_form.window_convention: STRICT_NEXT_BAR declared ex-ante: signals computed on session t close data under last_avail < gate(t); fills at the NEXT allowed session close (no same-session fill, no SAME_DAY_INCLUSIVE variant anywhere); a fill references only names with a bar at the fill session; missing bar = the order does not exist (no silent substitute pricing).
book_form.provision_2_1_status: the sector-residual (ETF-leg) provision of plan section 2 is deliberately NOT invoked: the book holds cohort equities only. Justification, frozen here before selection: per-sector net-zero construction already neutralizes sector exposure without paying ETF-leg costs and without diluting exit-at-last-close dead-leg honesty; the frozen exposure, ETF-share and SPY-excess gates apply unchanged to this form.
book_form.holding: one grid step (21 trading sessions) with rank hysteresis: a held name is retained until its rank exits its tercile band by more than one decile (effective holding 1-2 quarters); book forced flat at every fold boundary.
book_form.dead_leg_exit: exit-at-last-close: a held name whose series ends is exited at its last recorded close on its final session; exit costs via resolve_exit_band_bps, never the silent 10 bps fallback (L-I3 fail-closed).

costs.model: inherited band model, charged exactly once per fill, linear in fills, applied to BOOKED PnL, no sidecar: research/assets/stocks/kernel_band_cost_v9.py verbatim - BAND_BPS = {"A": 10.0, "B": 15.0, "C": 25.0} bps per side; band_of: ADV63 >= 50,000,000 -> A, >= 10,000,000 -> B, >= 2,000,000 -> C, else UNTRADABLE; fill_cost_bps = abs(dw) * resolve_band_bps(name, bands) * cost_mult / 10_000.0.
costs.fail_closed: a traded name without a computed band at costing raises BandResolutionError - the silent 10 bps fallback is forbidden (L-I3); an entry never reaches costing with an UNTRADABLE band; exits of held names use resolve_exit_band_bps (own band when tradable, C-rate 25 bps ceiling when UNTRADABLE/missing).
costs.stress: stress rerun is cost_mult 2.0 (20/30/50 bps per side) applied to booked PnL; reported alongside base; stress-tier survival is a primary stage-A gate.
costs.expected_blend: the short leg skews to localized-defect, often lower-dollar-volume names, so the blended base cost is expected between 15 and 25 bps per side; fills, cost and booked PnL reported split by band for base AND stress.

stage_a_gate_table.basis: frozen gates carried verbatim from research/control/stocks_free_v12_run/p3_v12_invariants_freeze.json (carried_payload + v12_additions); no relaxation anywhere; margin-to-fail reported per gate per P-2 on any survivor.

gates.threshold: ETF positive share <= 0.50 (expected 0.00 by no-ETF-leg construction; binding if an implementation path ever introduced ETF legs)
risk-matched SPY-excess alpha > 0 overall AND positive in >= 1/3 of folds (>= 1 of 3)
anchor expectancy > 0 under the cost_mult 2.0 stress rerun on booked PnL

drop-one symbol (after-drop expectancy > 0), drop-one fold (min over leave-one-fold-out expectancies > 0), drop-one process-leg (sign preservation and expectancy > 0 on the declared restricted recompute) all pass

control |alpha| < 0.5x anchor |alpha|; FALSIFICATION RULE: control reproduces the anchor same-sign >= 0.5x on the identifying metric (anchor overall risk-matched SPY-excess alpha) -> family DEAD (falsification-by-control cluster)

distance-to-threshold reported for every gate (P-2) before any remediation can shock it; a survivor with knife-edge margins (< 0.05 PF margin, < 25% MDD headroom) is reported thin regardless of pass count

failure_interpretation.preregistration: REJECT, BLOCKED and NOT_RUN are successful outcomes; there is no rescue, no threshold change, no universe change, no cost change, no gate change after PnL is visible - any such change is forbidden rescue.
failure_interpretation.anchor_expectancy_le_0: correction-mass localization is already efficiently priced on this cohort or does not transmit to relative returns - withdraw the family.
failure_interpretation.control_ratio_ge_0.5_same_sign: the spread is a distributional artifact of the exposure's shape, not entity-linked structure information - family dies; this is the pre-declared falsification outcome and a successful test (falsification-by-control cluster, V11 precedent on this same census).
failure_interpretation.neighbour_opposite_sign: the concentration reading is not coherent with worst-chain severity - withdraw the localization interpretation (support-failure, not a tuning opportunity).
failure_interpretation.folds_positive_lt_2_or_fold_positive_sha: the effect does not survive regime change - die.
failure_interpretation.spy_excess_fail: the spread is market/sector context, not incremental information - die (the measured sector-drowning lesson applied to this family).
failure_interpretation.stress_tier_fail: the margin does not survive doubled costs - die.
failure_interpretation.etf_share_gt_0.50: sector leakage through the book construction - die.
failure_interpretation.populated_fold_pf_lt_0.8: the book degrades to noise in some regime - die.
failure_interpretation.drop_one_fail: the effect is a single symbol, single fold, or single process-leg artifact - die.
failure_interpretation.pre_selection_gate_fail_R1_R5: die at D2 before any scored cell (INELIGIBLE_*); the design never reaches PnL - the cheap death, correctly taken.
failure_interpretation.novelty_fail: the structure conditioning is a hedged relabelling of a vetoed ancestor - die at D2; measured, never argued.
failure_interpretation.availability_lag_mutation_fail: implementation leak - the arm is NOT_RUN fail-closed; no repair after PnL is visible.
failure_interpretation.thin_margin_rule: a survivor with knife-edge margins (< 0.05 PF margin, < 25% MDD headroom) is reported thin per P-2 regardless of pass count and is treated as candidate-not-edge.

d2_predeclarations.a_conditioning_exposure_definition: EXACT formula for A1's pooled |rho| <= 0.20 measurement vs the THIRTEEN-entry veto set, pre-selection: at each frozen decision date t (gate(t) = 00:00 UTC of the session), for entity e of the bookable pool: Q(e,t) = { (f, p) depth>=2 chain groups of e in the staged revision layer (sha256 7110cbf010ae6d3f414a1a45eec1e504aff5e94464755991e98605e4795657c2) satisfying last_avail(g) < gate(t) and 0 <= t - last_avail(g) <= 800 days }. Exposure value: conc(e,t) = max_g excess(g) / sum_g excess(g) with excess(g) = depth(g) - 2, defined iff |Q(e,t)| >= 4, with the declared degenerate-case mapping sum_g excess(g) = 0 -> 0.0 (the diffuse floor). Inputs read: entity, field, period, depth, last_avail ONLY - no price, no corrected value, no direction, no magnitude, no inter_arrival, no span. D2 computes the pooled Spearman rank correlation (midrank ties, pooled over all frozen decision dates and the measured cohort) between this raw exposure rank vector and each veto entry's exposure; gate |rho| <= 0.20 per entry, measured before any selection.
d2_predeclarations.b_anchor_vs_control_identifiability: pre-declared, measured at D2 before selection: (R1) pooled |mean Spearman rho| between the anchor rank vector and the shuffled-control rank vector <= 0.30, and per-date rho <= 0.30 on >= 90% of dates (declared expected band 0.00-0.10: a within-sector marginal-preserving permutation leaves expected rank correlation near zero); explicit self-subsumption check per the V15 lesson: if the anchor-vs-control pooled rho exceeds 0.98 the control is a relabelling of the anchor and the proposal dies pre-score - a control that cannot be distinguished from its anchor is a design failure, not a pass; (R2) control non-degeneracy: by marginal preservation the control terciles populate with the anchor's own counts - measured anyway: both control terciles contain >= 6 names on >= 90% of dates.
d2_predeclarations.c_placebo_calendar_constraints: this lane's MANDATORY control is the shuffled-chain permutation, not a calendar placebo - no event-window book exists in this family, so no sham/filer-event calendar is consumed. Constraints recorded for completeness from the census: filer-event placebo clear windows 8,034,881 (w5) / 7,044,549 (w20), 2,158/2,161 entities with >= 1 runnable w5 window - available substrate this design does not occupy. The 671 UNMAPPED-sector dead entities with no matched living sham host are an AXIS-2 (death-event lane) design constraint and bind no arm here; UNMAPPED chain-class mass in the V12 census is 0. The 120 out-of-series sham anchors are likewise axis-2 census facts, not lane-1 constraints.

diagnostic_commitments.contract: the scored driver persists, per the P3-frozen diagnostic_output_contract (P-11) that this proposal is designed FOR: (1) per-period returns per arm per fold - the DSR series, computable at terminal over N = 39 + V12 cells from persisted bytes; (2) per-symbol/per-leg diagnostics; (3) margin-to-fail per gate (distance-to-threshold per P-2); (4) execution ledger with fill-level cost lines proving linear-in-fills and charge-exactly-once; (5) control-class series persisted ALONGSIDE the anchor series under IDENTICAL semantics (same decision dates, same gates, same tercile machinery, same cost model); (6) the neighbour series under the same contract.
diagnostic_commitments.validation: artifacts are relative-path-only with schema_id resolving to the registered diag/<category>@1; research/governance/diagnostic_persistability.py validates the contract BEFORE A7 launch authorization - any gap is BLOCKED_PRELAUNCH; the twin smoke-run must re-emit the series; machine-wide heavy lock for every heavy job (contention = NOT_RUN_RESOURCE_CONFLICT, never spin); failure-registry append at close via the Lead with --verify PASS.

warmup_rationale: the exposure reads evidenced depth counts directly per as-of chain group (a max/sum ratio of bounded counts; no own_norm/cohort_norm seeding, no delta-of-levels legs - the V8 F2 ratio-level precedent warmup 0); the grid's index-63 start already seeds the 63-bar and ADV63 eligibility floors; those floors are eligibility/cost machinery, not signal warmup. The P3-frozen min_hist cohort floor (30) is unused by design: no cohort normalization exists anywhere in this family.

decision_grid.schedule: inherited 21-session grid: sessions at indices 63+21k from each fold start (k = 0, 1, 2, ...), pure session-index schedule, no calendar anchoring; approximately 26-28 scored decisions per fold, >= 75 overall (exact counts fixed by the session grid before scoring).
decision_grid.no_finer_grid_rationale: no finer grid demanded and none declared: vintage stamps accrue at the annual reporting rhythm (the modal depth-2 chain completes in ~364 days per the census span quantiles), so a 21-session step cannot systematically sample inside a sub-step arrival, and the availability-lag mutation guarantees stamp shifts propagate by whole evidence stamps, not intra-grid timing.

entry_exit_fills.signal_semantics: signals computed on session t close data under last_avail < gate(t), gate(t) = 00:00 UTC of the decision session; fills at the next allowed session close (STRICT_NEXT_BAR; no same-session fill).
entry_exit_fills.fill_check: a fill references only names with a bar at the fill session; missing bar = the order does not exist (no silent substitute pricing).
entry_exit_fills.exit_at_last_close: a held name whose series ends is exited at its last recorded close on its final session (delisting-return leg carried by the price series itself; no synthetic penalty, no synthetic continuation); exit costs via resolve_exit_band_bps - C-rate ceiling when the band has become UNTRADABLE/missing, never the silent fallback (L-I3 fail-closed).
entry_exit_fills.portfolio_construction: per-sector net-zero long-short terciles as declared in book_form; gross capped 2.0; forced flat at fold boundaries; books reconcile to 1.0 within 1e-9.

exposure_definition: At each decision date t (session gate g(t) = 00:00 UTC of session t), for entity e: Q(e,t) = { (f, p) chain groups of e in the staged revision layer (.staging_sec_v10/v10_revision_observables.jsonl, sha256 7110cbf010ae6d3f414a1a45eec1e504aff5e94464755991e98605e4795657c2; one row per depth>=2 filer-field-period group) satisfying last_avail(g) < g(t) and 0 <= t - last_avail(g) <= 800 days }. Exposure value: conc(e,t) = max_g excess(g) / sum_g excess(g) where excess(g) = depth(g) - 2, defined iff |Q(e,t)| >= 4; entities with |Q| < 4 are ineligible (not zero-ranked); the degenerate case sum_g excess(g) = 0 maps to 0.0 (the diffuse floor) by the declared ex-ante convention - monotone-consistent, principled, not tuned. Ranking direction: descending conc = short side, ascending = long side. Normalization: none beyond the ratio itself (raw value used for ranking AND for the D2 veto measurement - the within-sector tercile standardization applied for trading is monotone within sector and the veto is measured on the raw pooled rank, midrank ties, the conservative choice). Inputs: depth, last_avail, and the group key only; no price, no level ratio, no delta-of-levels, no corrected value, no direction, no magnitude, no span, no inter-arrival, no first_avail value. The same formula, evaluated on the same cohort and frozen decision dates, is what D2 ranks against each of the THIRTEEN veto entries (Spearman, midrank ties, pooled).

pre_selection_identifiability_check.purpose: the V8 a5 / V15 lessons: control identifiability and anchor non-vacuity must be measurable BEFORE selection, from data alone, no PnL in existence.
pre_selection_identifiability_check.rule: On every frozen decision date t over S0_FOLD_1/2/3, over the pre-check universe = bookable-pool names with >= 63 price bars through t (bar counts from the sha-pinned staged price bars; NO band computation, NO returns): (R1) RANK GATE - pooled |mean Spearman rho| between the anchor rank vector and the shuffled-control rank vector <= 0.30, and per-date rho <= 0.30 on >= 90% of dates (declared expected band 0.00-0.10); plus the explicit V15 self-subsumption check: pooled anchor-vs-control rho > 0.98 -> dies pre-score; (R2) CONTROL NON-DEGENERACY - by marginal preservation the control terciles populate with the anchor's own counts; measured anyway: both control terciles contain >= 6 names on >= 90% of dates; (R3) ANCHOR COVERAGE - the anchor rank is populated on >= 60% of the measured universe on >= 90% of dates; (R4) ANCHOR SHORT-LEG POPULATION - the anchor's top tercile contains >= 6 names with conc > 0 on >= 90% of dates; (R5) SECTOR PARTICIPATION - on >= 90% of dates, >= 60% of the measured universe sits in sectors passing the >= 6-name rule (else the book is too abstaining to trade). Declared expected outcome: R1 in the 0.00-0.10 band. Any gate failure blocks the proposal BEFORE selection (INELIGIBLE_CONTROL_UNIDENTIFIABLE / INELIGIBLE_VACUOUS_CONTROL / INELIGIBLE_BOOK_UNPOPULATED, fail-closed); the check runs at D2 alongside novelty and its bytes are published before any scored cell.
pre_selection_identifiability_check.inputs: the staged revision layer under the cited clock + staged price bar availability ONLY; no ADV, no cost model, no returns - nothing scored exists at measurement time.

incremental_alpha_test.vs_SPY: incremental alpha = arm return minus risk-matched SPY context (SPY scaled ex ante by the arm's frozen gross/vol rule per the P3-carried factor/benchmark protocol), per fold and overall; require overall SPY-excess alpha > 0 AND positive in >= 1/3 of folds (binding at scoring); raw PnL or long-equity beta is never accepted as alpha.
incremental_alpha_test.vs_sector_ETF: same test against the equal-weight mapped sector-ETF factor (SPY + 11 SPDR sector files, verified-by-pin); the book is per-sector net zero so residual sector drift appears as reported tracking error, not alpha.
incremental_alpha_test.etf_share_gate: ETF positive share <= 0.50 where ETF legs exist; this book declares NO ETF legs (provision 2.1 not invoked), so the measured share is expected 0.00 with the gate binding only if an implementation path ever introduced ETF legs.

turnover_and_sample_floor.decisions_total: >= 30 scored decision periods overall (declared grid approx. 78); >= 5 per fold.
turnover_and_sample_floor.turnover_convention: turnover = sum(abs(delta_weight)) over non-CASH legs (V3 ADJ-5 corrected); annualized two-way with hysteresis expected below the 6.0/year ceiling; raw and ceiling-normalized reported.
turnover_and_sample_floor.floor_mechanics: min 5 decision periods per fold; min 1 non-CASH leg per decision; CASH excluded from turnover, concentration and drop-one; force-flat at fold boundaries.

drop_one_design: drop-one-symbol: rerun excluding the max-contribution symbol; survival requires after-drop expectancy > 0 (dead-leg names are legitimate exclusions; the max contributor may be a dying name - that is a legitimate drop, not a special case).
drop-one-fold: min over folds of expectancy with that fold removed; survival requires min > 0.

drop-one-process-leg: recompute conc with the mildest excess tier removed - excess'(g) = depth(g) - 3 for groups with depth >= 4 (the depth-3 single-extra-patch leg is dropped from the mass entirely); survival requires sign preservation and expectancy > 0; if the concentration premium exists only as an artifact of the mildest re-addressal tier, the localization reading is withdrawn.

mutual_distinctness_declaration.distinction: H1 is the EXTENSIVE margin of chain strain: a threshold-coded tail share (deep_share = fraction of the entity's as-of chain groups at depth >= 6) - how much of the book is deep. H2 is the INTENSIVE margin: a threshold-free max/sum ratio over excess depth (depth minus the modal 2) across the entity's chains - where the re-addressal mass sits (one pathological chain vs diffuse patches).
mutual_distinctness_declaration.not_relabellings_because: (1) different mathematical object: binary-coded tail mass of a threshold indicator vs a normalized concentration ratio with no threshold constant anywhere; (2) they disagree structurally in both directions - an entity with many chains uniformly at depth 6-8 ranks HIGH on H1 and NEAR THE DIFFUSE FLOOR on H2, while an entity with one depth-15+ chain in a shallow book ranks LOW on H1 and NEAR 1 on H2; (3) different economic reading: machinery-wide chronic burden vs a localized specific defect (the account-specific material-weakness story); (4) different failure interpretations: H1's drop-one-process-leg removes the modal depth-2 denominator mass, H2's removes the mildest excess tier (depth-3); (5) different controls: distinct frozen permutation seeds (20260908 vs 20260909) applied to DIFFERENT anchor exposure vectors, so the permuted multisets - the control universes - are different objects. The pooled rank correlation between the two anchors is expected positive (both increase with depth-tail mass) but is not the identity; D2 measures and reports it as wave-diversity evidence, and if the measured pooled rho exceeded 0.98 the two anchors would be self-subsumptions of one another and BOTH would die pre-score under the V15 lesson - declared here, binding.
mutual_distinctness_declaration.shared_nothing_else: both proposals share only the inherited cohort/sector/cost/grid machinery that every V9-V12 family shares (P3-frozen payload); no exposure input, no threshold, no control seed is shared.
